Any compatible load cell(s) may be used providing the following conditions are met: - There is a respective OIML Certificate of Conformity (R60) issued for the load cell. - The certificate contains the load cell types and the necessary load cell data required for the manufacturer’s declaration of compatibility of modules and any particular installation requirements. ISSUE NO.DATEDESCRIPTION
R51/2006-GB1-09.0517 November 2009Certificate first issued.
